title: Seize the Moment: Turning Market Slowdown into Opportunity
subtitle: Transform market challenges into triumphs. Leverage current conditions to structure winning deals for your borrowers.
keyTakeaways: Leverage reduced competition to negotiate favorable terms for borrowers.
Utilize PRO Portal to run multiple pricing scenarios and optimize loan structures.
Stay informed on market shifts to provide strategic borrower guidance.
Maximize borrower leverage with slight improvements in mortgage rates.

sections.heading: Understanding the Market Shift
sections.body: With pending home sales experiencing a significant decline, the buyer landscape has shifted. This change presents an opportunity for brokers to secure better deals for their clients.
bullets: Negotiate seller concessions and closing-cost credits.
Consider temporary or permanent rate buydowns.

sections.heading: Strategize with PRO Portal
sections.body: Harness the capabilities of the PRO Portal to structure deals that meet your borrowers' needs. Use its live rate updates and pricing scenarios to find the optimal solution before making an offer.
bullets: Lock in favorable rates with flexibility.

sections.heading: Preparing Borrowers for Success
sections.body: Ensure your borrowers are positioned to act quickly and decisively when opportunities arise. Educate them on the benefits of negotiating in a less competitive market.
bullets: Highlight purchase price adjustments and repair credits.
Guide borrowers through the negotiation process.

metaDescription: Capitalize on the market slowdown: structure smarter deals with UFF's PRO Portal. Act now.
